# alcove.software

Alcove is local-first search infrastructure.

- Retrieval over operator-controlled corpora.
- Local disk by default.
- AI optional, not mandatory.
- Retrieval, not generation.

Primary codebase: https://github.com/Spitfire-Cowboy/alcove

Audience pages:
- Home (private prototype and recorded demo): https://alcove.software/home/
- Business (early use case, not a customer case study): https://alcove.software/business/
- Government (public Congress and LA law search projects): https://alcove.software/government/
